datum: Station 0 is 109.32 in forward of a jig point marked by a plate on the bulkhead between the flight compartment and the cabin (FAA TCDS A9EA Rev 15, p. 18). Maintenance manual wording (third-party excerpt): Station 0 is 60.00 in forward of the flight compartment front bulkhead.

mac.source: FAA TCDS A9EA Rev 15 p. 18 (FAA_TCDS_A9EA_paraclete_1.pdf); temac derived

weights.source: FAA TCDS A9EA p. 12 and p. 20; Series 400 empty weight from Viking Twin Otter Series 400 Technical Specifications 2018 p. 1

envelopes.name: Series 300 landplane and wheel-skiplane, take-off
envelopes.lower_bound_note: 9000 lb is the bottom of the TCDS chart frame, not a declared limit; the TCDS text gives the aft limit as 36 % MAC at all weights and the forward limit as 20 % MAC below 11600 lb. Extend both vertical segments downward for lighter weights.
envelopes.source: FAA TCDS A9EA Rev 15 p. 12, figure 'C.G. range (Landing gear fixed)', values printed on the figure (file FAA_TCDS_A9EA_paraclete_1.pdf, raster tcds_p12-12.png); identical figure redrawn to 6000 lb in MSFS2024 AOM p. 44 (third party)

envelopes.name: Series 300 floatplane (CAP 12000A/B), all phases
envelopes.lower_bound_note: forward 25 % MAC and aft 32 % MAC at all weights up to 12500 lb; no lower weight bound stated

envelopes.name: Series 300 parachuting configuration (air operable door, AFM Supplement 23)
envelopes.lower_bound_note: No specific envelope or 'aft CG with cargo door removed' restriction found in the documents obtained. FlightSafety PTM p. 45 refers to AFM Supplement 23 for the air operable (bi-fold) parachute door. MSFS2024 AOM p. 44 (third party) lists: door closed for take-off, landing and single-engine; 140 KIAS max door open; drops at flaps 20 deg and 70 KIAS; occupancy limited to crew and parachutists.

fuel.source: FAA TCDS A9EA p. 13 and p. 20; Viking Series 400 Technical Specifications p. 1

cabin.front_bulkhead_note: derived from datum definition (jig point on cockpit/cabin bulkhead); 332 - 109.32 = 222.7 in, consistent with the 221 in cabin length

left_double_door_airstair_plus_cargo.note: combined opening 50 x 56 in (1.27 x 1.42 m); aft half is the dual cargo door, forward half the detachable airstair door; located just aft of the wing trailing edge on the left side; exact FS not found

parachute_roll_up_or_bifold_door.note: replaces both left cabin doors (same frame); air operable roll-up (plastic on rails) or inward-opening bi-fold; dimensions not found in an official source; AFM Supplement 23

cabin.seating_commuter: 19/20 seats: 7 rows, 6 double seats left plus 1 single aft, 5 single seats right plus up to 3 optional seats forward of the rear baggage compartment (FlightSafety PTM Fig. 1-10, p. 37)
cabin.source: Viking Series 400 Technical Specifications 2018 p. 1 and Brochure p. 3 (cabin and doors); FAA TCDS A9EA p. 18 (floor waterline); Viking Parachute sheet (STN 332); FlightSafety PTM p. 37 and p. 40
